en: Dependent on a non-manifesting, non-reactive resultant state, a non-manifesting, non-reactive state that is not a result arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Six with root; six with predominance … pe … three with mutuality … pe … six with non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-manifesting, non-reactive state that has the nature of resulting, a non-manifesting, non-reactive state that does not have the nature of resulting arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Six with root; six with predominance … pe … six with non-disappearance.

Dependent on that which is non-demonstrable, non-reacting, neither-resultant-nor-producing-resultant, there arises that which is not non-demonstrable-and-reacting, neither-resultant-nor-producing-resultant, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
